page.overview:
What is 4.5V?

4.5V used to be the voltage standard for the first electric components (e.g — part of LEGO.

motors, lights) in certain LEGO sets. The power came from a battery box with 3x 1.5V batteries.

Beside Basic sets and TECHNIC sets, the 4.5V standard was used for motorization of the first electric LEGO Trains which marked a long era from 1966 to 1986. The 4.5V standard was later used for battery powered DUPLO Trains.
